title: Marching order and horn placement in parades
summary: Tubas walked in front, then baritones, trombones, altos, trumpets, clarinets, drums; Esau Lewis on E-flat trumpet playing lead.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs
